mapper.sql: transfer_id AS transferId, instance_id AS instanceId, target_type AS targetType, target_id AS targetId, from_user_id AS fromUserId, to_user_id AS toUserId, reason, transferred_by AS transferredBy, create_time AS createTime
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_workflow_transfer (transfer_id, instance_id, target_type, target_id, from_user_id, to_user_id, reason, transferred_by, create_time) VALUES (#{row.transferId}, #{row.instanceId}, #{row.targetType}, #{row.targetId}, #{row.fromUserId}, #{row.toUserId}, #{row.reason}, #{row.transferredBy}, #{row.createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_workflow_transfer WHERE instance_id = #{instanceId} ORDER BY create_time, transfer_id
